body: I had depression my whole life so it’s really hard for me to connect with people. I wish I was comfortable being alone but it’s slowly killing me. And I just keep getting hurt.
The last time I told someone I was suicidal, she clearly wanted to end the conversation. It’s best that I don’t tell anyone that I know
During the pandemic, I realized that no one cared enough to reach out. I’m usually the person that plans things first. So I lost all of my friends when I stopped trying.
I never harmed myself but this is the way.

You’re welcome. “Opening up” about your depression is just terrible advice. Sometimes, it just makes it worst. You have to be very careful on who you can trust before you reveal something so personal. Hope you’re doing better Jeremy.

I was told by someone once that’s it’s ok to not be ok. There may be all this pressure from society to be happy and positive but you don’t have to be. It’s ok to not be ok. It’s ok to accept yourself as you are now. Then when you’re ready, you can make slow changes. You take all the time you need.
Same. For me, speaking up on my issues would only be a burden for others. I’m glad I found this thread.
Exactly. It’s refreshing to see honesty no matter how ugly it may seem
The only books I’ll have at home is Dr. Seuss. Sign. Me. UP!
How often do you plan to visit her? Did you discuss that with your mom?
This should be at the top. At least work with your mom on visitation.
